plan: REPLACE: short name of the plan

risks.title: REPLACE: five to ten words naming the risk

evidence.quote: REPLACE: verbatim text from the plan

risks.scenario: REPLACE: how it fails and what that costs, in one or two sentences
risks.detection: REPLACE: the earliest observable sign that it is happening
risks.mitigation: REPLACE: the smallest change to the plan that removes or contains it

not_checked: REPLACE: what could not be verified from the plan text
